messages:
vivian: FYI I hit a weird auth-drop when using redwoodctl inside a WSL2 dev container. Installed via apt repo. Start `redwoodctl localserve --profile ci-test` and then restart the systemd user service that manages our container (`systemctl --user restart containerd`) -> localserve immediately logs that active_profile switched to 'default' and asks for login. super noisy during tests.

vivian: Minimal repro:
1) apt install redwoodctl (from packages.redwood.dev)
2) echo 'ci-test' > ~/.config/redwood/active_profile
3) create profile token at ~/.config/redwood/config.json
4) run `redwoodctl localserve --profile ci-test`
5) in another shell `systemctl --user restart containerd`
6) observe localserve: `config: active_profile=default` then `[auth] no credentials for profile 'default'`

noah: hmm, related to in-place config reloading on d-bus user session restart? when systemd user restarts the environment it can re-source /etc/profile.d; do you have any system-level config writing active_profile?

vivian: yes our packager placed `/etc/redwood/defaults.conf` with `active_profile=default` to ensure first-run UX. That file gets re-evaluated on session restart and ends up overwriting the user file when our daemon checks for defaults.

noah: two ideas: 1) packagers should not write to /etc for mutable user state (move to /usr/share/redwood/defaults.conf and only read, never write), 2) runtime should prefer explicit per-user config (~/.config/redwood) over system defaults and never overwrite it automatically.

hunter: adding: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/issues/1601 (packaging: system defaults clobber user active_profile on user-session restart). I'll sketch a PR to change installer behavior and to make localserve treat system defaults as read-only.

devex-bot: Tagged @devex, label: packaging, localdev; suggested workaround: remove or rename /etc/redwood/defaults.conf until fix.

vivian: confirmed renaming /etc/redwood/defaults.conf stops the behavior. Thanks, will leave a note in our onboarding docs about package caveats for WSL/systemd users.

noah: also recommend adding `--no-auto-config` flag to localserve for CI/dev loops so in-process updates or session restarts don't rewrite runtime config.
